C02 and C18 contain related coordination and reporting machinery, but their language and structures are less closely aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It would be a great service to the nation's capital if you would undertake to confer with the appropriate agencies","parent_excerpt":"It would greatly stimulate the speed and effectiveness of this program if you would consider appointing a Governor's Committee","explanation":"Both use an “It would…” conditional request to enlist the recipient in an administrative action intended to accelerate an existing public program."},{"child_excerpt":"I am certain you can render a service of great value.","parent_excerpt":"Your assistance in this great humanitarian program ... will be a genuine service to many communities within your state.","explanation":"Both conclude the request by describing the recipient’s prospective assistance as a significant public service."},{"child_excerpt":"The redevelopment and renewal ... is of concern not only to the citizens of the District of Columbia but to all the American people.","parent_excerpt":"With America's traditional concern for the homeless, the persecuted, and the less fortunate of other lands","explanation":"Each frames the specific administrative project as an expression of a broader American concern before making the request."}]}
